title: the Marlowe Estate Rising
author: Jonah Eriksen
blurb: Ulyana Quintana, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
